name: Grom the Paunch
canonNotes: Goblin Warlord of the Misty Mountain, notorious for a gigantic appetite and for invading Ulthuan itself.
Rides a chariot pulled by great wolves, with his standard bearer Niblit.
voiceNotes: Gluttonous, jovial and boastful; always hungry for food and loot.
Shrewder than he looks; loves bragging about eating his enemies.
ttsInstructions: Greedy, jolly and boastful, with a gurgling belly laugh.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
